name: Carport HW - Rev1 through first mass-production shipment release
description: Hardware development proposal as of 2026-10-31. Rev0 complete; Rev1 schematic out for review and layout underway. US/Canada initial markets; international expansion later. NTN remains evaluation with explicit Rev2 gate. Dates are dependency-calculated estimates; named staffing, supplier commitments, quantities and lab slots unconfirmed. Software has separate backlogs and appears only as delivery gates. Read docs/carport-hw-planning-basis.md for scope, assumptions, qualification strategy and source register. No historical actual dates or invented progress. Baseline is an unapproved proposal. Qualification starts on Rev2 for suitable electrical/conducted work; enclosure-sensitive campaigns start on representative T1 while T2 proceeds. Final T2 delta review/retests protect market release. The original unapproved proposal baseline is preserved.

engineering.name: Engineering / US-Canada lab planning - Mon-Fri
engineering.description: 8-hour weekday planning assumption. Dec 24-Jan 1 team/lab closure is provisional; holidays are editable capacity assumptions, not a legal holiday calendar.

supplier.name: Overseas supplier - provisional Mon-Fri + shutdown
supplier.description: Country not selected. Conservative placeholder for a China-based partner: Feb 1-19 2027 Spring Festival capacity closure, not an official holiday notice. Replace with vendor-confirmed factory calendar. No assumed Saturday overtime.

transit.name: Express transport elapsed days - 7 days/week
transit.description: Calendar-day freight allowance; actual customs/carrier schedule and local receiving availability must be confirmed. Evaluation uses engineering calendar.

assumptions: US + Canada first confirmed by operator; later-market expansion is separate scope.
Satellite remains unproven evaluation; decision before Rev2 freeze controls enabled features, antenna/firmware and certification scope.
Forecast starts next working Monday 2026-11-02; actual historical dates and current percent complete are not known.
Role owners are accountable functions, not staffed resource commitments; model is precedence scheduled, not capacity leveled.
Rev1 and Rev2 PCBA each 15 supplier workdays plus 5 calendar-day express shipping; availability is unquoted.
T1 nominal 20 supplier workdays cut + 5 supplier workdays trial + 5 calendar-day shipping + 5 engineering workdays evaluation; nominal about 6-8 weeks before closure/other predecessor impact.

T2 nominal 10 supplier workdays correction + 2 supplier workdays trial + 5 calendar-day express transport + 10 engineering workdays evaluation; about 4-6 weeks after correction release. Assumes minor correction only.
One minor retest reserve 10 workdays; major respin/new tool/new battery qualification is not absorbed into this buffer.
Overseas country unknown: provisional supplier closure Feb 1-19 2027 must be replaced with agreed actual factory holiday dates; not an official holiday claim.
No pricing or PO commitment; quantities, performance thresholds and MP demand require gate approval.
Cert/qualification durations are planning allowances, not promised lab service times or a determination of legal applicability.
Transit is 7-day calendar; engineering and overseas supplier work on separate calendars. No sea freight in baseline.
Electrical/conducted/network work starts after a 2-working-day Rev2 incoming bring-up; remaining 8-day Rev2 verification runs in parallel on separate units.
Early printed housings and handmade screen/ePTFE support suitable Rev2 tests with lab-recorded limitations; formal enclosure-sensitive campaigns use lab-accepted representative T1 assemblies.

T2 corrections are minor; a 3-day test-impact review plus 10-day affected-retest reserve carries Rev2/T1 evidence forward only where lab/quality accept it. No fresh full certification campaign is assumed after T2 unless changes require it.

tasks.name: 01 - Current position and program decisions
Planning start - Rev0 complete; Rev1 schematic in review and layout underway
tasks.acceptance: Status supplied 2026-10-31. Historical completion dates and percent complete are unknown; this is a planning anchor, not the actual Rev0 completion date.

tasks.name: Confirm US/Canada launch requirements and installation envelope
tasks.acceptance: Approved requirements: intended install location; 12 V baseline versus 24 V requirement; temperature, humidity, ingress, acoustic, GNSS, antenna, vehicle mounting, safe behavior and operating/survival power envelope. US + Canada launch confirmed; other markets are later change-controlled scope.

tasks.name: Agree certification and qualification matrix with accredited lab
tasks.acceptance: Written US FCC / Canada ISED route, exact ESP32 and nRF module grants/integration conditions, antennas and gains, RF exposure/use distance and simultaneous transmit cases; host emissions, GNSS receive performance, cellular/operator and Bluetooth qualification scope. Evaluate safety/battery/shipping and vehicle approval applicability. Lab quote, sample counts, modes and slot strategy recorded. Agree which electrical, conducted RF, network/protocol and documentation results may be accepted from Rev2 in printed housings; identify enclosure-sensitive tests, representative T1 sample requirements and T2 delta/retest rules.

tasks.name: Select overseas build partners and reserve indicative capacity
tasks.acceptance: PCBA, mold/assembly and membrane/cable vendors shortlisted; quotes, Incoterms, import responsibility, tooling ownership, payment/release gates, English controlled drawings, weekly overlap meeting and change approval process. Lead times remain estimates until supplier commits. Confirm actual holidays/country.

tasks.name: Approve sample allocation and destructive-test budgets
tasks.acceptance: Allocate serialized boards/housings by test; suggested Rev1 15 boards, Rev2 30 boards, T1 20 sets, T2 60 sets, PVT 100 units subject to lab needs, destructive tests, spares, budget and demand. Counts are proposals, not purchase authorizations. Allocate separate early Rev2 electrical/conducted test units, T1 chamber/RF units, destructive-test spares and retained reference samples so parallel tracks do not share unavailable hardware.

tasks.name: Evaluate physical SIM / eUICC provider and roaming
tasks.acceptance: Provider comparison covers US/Canada LTE-M/NB-IoT coverage, roaming/permanent roaming, PSM/eDRX, APN, activation, provisioning, supply/form factor, profile lifecycle, cost and operator approvals. Bench attach evidence and fallback physical SIM choice. Do not assume eSIM is merely a socket substitution.

tasks.name: Evaluate nRF9151 satellite service and supported hardware/firmware
tasks.acceptance: Check actual nRF9151 build code, compatible NTN modem/NCS release, provider service/bands/coverage, antenna/sky view, TN/NTN transitions, SIM profile, power budget, test access and approval route. Record working eval evidence or remaining gaps; not yet a launch promise.

tasks.name: G0 - Requirements, test strategy and supplier assumptions accepted
tasks.acceptance: Requirements, launch markets, qualification plan, sample budget and accountable role assignments accepted. Named owners and capacity still to be assigned.

tasks.name: 02 - Rev1 PCB and prototype housing release
Close Rev1 schematic review and BOM metadata
tasks.acceptance: Resolve reviewer comments and R2-03 MPN/tolerance/voltage/dielectric metadata; regenerate correct dev/production variants, BOM and netlist; run Altium compiler/ERC; unresolved risks have written containment. Saved source, reviewed PDF and exports agree.

tasks.name: Bound Rev1 input fault stresses before destructive testing
tasks.acceptance: Declare reverse battery, jump start, crank, pulse/load dump and USB overlap envelopes. Close R2-04 reverse comparator-pin injection allowance and transient peak/terminal stresses, or implement safe changes/bench containment. Static simulation alone is not fault qualification.

tasks.name: Complete Rev1 routing and RF / power / mechanical review
tasks.acceptance: Layout review checks switcher hot loops, return paths, antenna keep-outs/feed/matching, GNSS isolation, debug/test access, thermal copper, USB, pigtail, button/LED alignment, board outline and tolerances. DRC and 3D clearance review pass.

tasks.name: Rev1 PCBA DFM, AVL availability and release package
tasks.acceptance: CM acknowledges controlled fabrication/assembly package, stackup, impedance, stencil, polarity, firmware/debug access, approved substitutions, DNP variants and long-lead material status. Do not treat old exports as current production files.

tasks.name: G1 - Release Rev1 PCBA prototype run
tasks.acceptance: Signed Rev1 build release; quote and proposed lot approved; Rev1 is an engineering prototype with fault-test restrictions documented.

tasks.name: Design clamshell and interfaces for prototype manufacture
tasks.acceptance: Two plastic shell halves; fastening/seal strategy, wall/rib/draft and tool parting concept. USB access/sealing, power pigtail strain-relief and pull load path, user button/RGB light path, ESP32 reset/boot and nRF reset access, mounting and antenna clearances are defined.

tasks.name: Select humidity vent and MEMS acoustic membrane stacks
tasks.acceptance: Evaluate ePTFE humidity exchange and acoustic vent separately: RH response, mic insertion loss/bandwidth, cavity geometry, adhesives, supported bond land, contamination/condensation, grill/screen protection and material compatibility. Sharing a port requires evidence; vent rating is not whole-product IP certification.

tasks.name: Print housing variants and hand-build membrane/grill/pigtail prototypes
tasks.acceptance: Printed shell fits and hand-applied ePTFE, screen/grill, light pipe, seals and strain relief available; build record captures orientation/material/adhesive/cure. Include vent-only coupons and cable pull fixtures.

tasks.name: Evaluate printed enclosure fit, acoustic/RH and cable interfaces
tasks.acceptance: Fit real board or verified dimensional surrogate; test button/LED/dev access, USB insertion, pigtail pull/bend, grille damage, mic response/RH lag and condensation. Printed/handmade performance is screening evidence, not molded-process qualification.

tasks.name: 03 - Rev1 EVT build and integrated learning
Fabricate and assemble Rev1 engineering boards
tasks.acceptance: CM assembly report, AOI/X-ray where appropriate, component traceability, serial numbers and approved substitutions; staged release of first boards if feasible.

tasks.name: Rev1 board shipment, import and incoming inspection
tasks.acceptance: Air shipment received with customs paperwork, count and visual inspection; shipping damage and build discrepancies logged.

tasks.name: External gate - Rev1 bring-up firmware and diagnostic tools
tasks.acceptance: Versioned Rev1 pin map, flash/storage change, sensor addressing, charger source policy, USB-only latch-off recovery, rail sequencing/back-power prevention, fuel-gauge configuration and diagnostic capture ready. Dashboard/carportpy/proto compatible. Deliverables managed in software backlogs.

tasks.name: Bring up Rev1 PCBA with current-limited staged power
tasks.acceptance: Supply currents/rails verified before radios; USB enumeration, debug recovery, sensor/mic/button/RGB, flash, reset/boot and UART tested. Record boot firmware, serial and measurement setup.

tasks.name: Rev1 power, input fault screening and radio transient tests
tasks.acceptance: Measure reverse/positive stress within declared envelope, brownout and crank recovery, USB-only/battery absent/depleted modes, charge/source limits after reset, 3.2 V radio droop, thermal/efficiency and sleep draw; no unresolved unsafe stress. Destructive tests use allocated units.

tasks.name: Rev1 antenna, coexistence and EMC pre-scan
tasks.acceptance: In representative enclosure/cabling, assess BLE/Wi-Fi/cellular transmit and GNSS receive sensitivity/TTFF, coexistence/desense and switcher noise; bench/conducted checks plus radiated pre-scan; antenna candidates, retuning needs and lab modes documented.

tasks.name: Rev1 integrated membrane, housing and sensor experiments
tasks.acceptance: RH step response/hysteresis, thermal self-heating, acoustic response/noise, condensation/ingress screening and cable pull/bend. Confirm antenna placement, button feel/light visibility and development button access on actual assembly.

tasks.name: G2 - Rev1 EVT findings and Rev2 change list approved
tasks.acceptance: Issue log contains root cause, severity, evidence and Rev2 disposition; power/RF/mechanical feasibility demonstrated. No automatic pass because boards powered up.

tasks.name: 04 - Rev2 and tool-ready design freeze
G3a - Cellular SIM and satellite launch decision
tasks.acceptance: Select provider/form factor and antenna/band plan. NTN either included with supported build/firmware/service and certification budget, or deferred with feature disabled and excluded from launch claims. Unresolved NTN requirement holds Rev2 freeze; no implicit terrestrial-only waiver.

tasks.name: Rev2 electrical changes, worst-case closure and schematic review
tasks.acceptance: Rev2 closes EVT defects, input protection and power margins, selected connectivity/SIM, release variant and test access; tolerance/temperature/DC bias calculations, reviewed schematic and BOM signed.

tasks.name: Rev2 layout, RF and DFM review
tasks.acceptance: Production-intent outline, stackup, antenna matching/keep-outs, switcher layout, cable interfaces and fixtures reviewed; DRC/ERC and CM DFM accepted. No speculative changes after freeze without ECO.

tasks.name: Tool-ready enclosure, vent process and cable assembly DFM
tasks.acceptance: Production resin, surface/texture, shrink/tolerances, fastening, draft/parting/ejection, undercuts, gasket, pigtail molding or grommet strategy, USB sealing, membrane bond lands and grill process finalized. Humidity and acoustic stack validated; tooling scope includes any separate strain-relief/insert tools.

tasks.name: Cross-discipline design risk and verification review
tasks.acceptance: DFMEA and DVP&R link failures to tests: water paths, membrane detachment/blockage, cable pull, user interface, thermal, battery, radio, vehicle transients and recovery; test severities and quantitative pass limits signed before formal runs.

tasks.name: Approve mold design, tooling contract and trial plan
tasks.acceptance: Supplier confirms T1/T2 definitions, cavities, tool steel/life/ownership, resin, inspection points, trial videos/data, samples, ECO turnaround, capacity, shipping and holiday calendar. Texture/irreversible steel changes held until fit acceptance.

tasks.name: G3 - Release Rev2 PCBA and housing tooling
tasks.acceptance: Controlled Rev2 electrical and mechanical release and PO approval. Freeze intended antennas, cables, resin, SIM/service scope and certification configuration. Long-lead commitments explicitly approved by operator.

tasks.name: 05 - Rev2 / T1 first molded integration
Build Rev2 production-intent boards
tasks.acceptance: Controlled Rev2 lot with serial/lot traceability, inspection and approved exact BOM; proposed 30 boards sized to qualification plan.

tasks.name: Ship and inspect Rev2 boards
tasks.acceptance: Received boards match released configuration and allocation; incoming results logged.

tasks.name: External gate - Rev2 DVT and RF test firmware
tasks.acceptance: Pinned ESP32/nRF/modem/NCS versions, Rev2 hardware profile, production-intent power policy, logging and RF test modes; shared contracts/protobuf and dashboard/carportpy compatibility matrix. NTN launch decision implemented. Separate software backlog owns development.

tasks.name: Rev2 incoming bring-up and early lab sample release
tasks.acceptance: Current-limited power-up, basic rails/current/USB/debug/radio checks pass; traceable Rev2 units, firmware, cables and declared electrical envelope released to parallel lab work. Printed shell and hand-cut screen/ePTFE permitted for tests whose results do not depend on final materials/process. Full fix verification continues on separate allocated units.

tasks.name: Complete Rev2 electrical fix verification alongside lab testing
tasks.acceptance: Repeat affected power/fault tests, flash/debug recovery, supply margin and radio/sensor checks; compare Rev1 findings and confirm final component variants. Newly discovered Rev3 requirement is an ECO and schedule replan, not hidden rework.

tasks.name: T1 - Cut clamshell and included strain-relief tooling
tasks.acceptance: Mold progress evidence and tool acceptance checkpoints; approved resin and inserts available. This is 20 supplier working days, excluding provisional closure; no claim that all overseas vendors meet it.

tasks.name: T1 - First shots, supplier metrology and assembly samples
tasks.acceptance: As-molded samples from intended resin, cavity IDs, molding parameters, dimensional FAI and cosmetic/warp/sink observations; fit PCB and pigtail locally before sending samples. Proposed 20 sets plus membrane coupons.

tasks.name: T1 - Air shipment and incoming sample inspection
tasks.acceptance: Samples and FAI received with revision/cavity traceability; retain supplier reference set.

tasks.name: T1 - Mechanical and electrical assembly evaluation
tasks.acceptance: Evaluate tolerances, fasteners, seam/USB/pigtail, pull/bend, button/RGB/dev access, vent/grill assembly, mic/RH and final antenna behavior with Rev2. Collect change list before tool correction release; first molded parts are not preproduction approval.

tasks.name: G4 - T1 integrated evaluation and correction list accepted
tasks.acceptance: T1 loop target 6-8 weeks after freeze without supplier closure; baseline uses 20 + 5 supplier workdays, 5 calendar days transit and 5 engineering workdays evaluation. Electrical availability may drive later finish; holiday impact is explicit in supplier calendar.

tasks.name: Rev2 EMC / RF readiness pre-scan using prototype housing
tasks.acceptance: Use Rev2 boards with printed housing, intended antennas/cables and documented handmade screen/ePTFE for early emissions/coexistence/GNSS scans. Track limitations; this pre-scan does not certify molded resin, final bonding/seal or antenna/mechanical equivalence. T1 lab sample release confirms representative setup before formal radiated work.

tasks.name: 06 - T2 correction and preproduction validation
Freeze T2 correction package and final test limits
tasks.acceptance: Signed tool/assembly correction list and required electrical ECO. Baseline assumes minor corrections, no PCB respin or new mold. Major changes trigger explicit additional loop and renewed certification impact review.

tasks.name: T2 - Tool corrections and process adjustments
tasks.acceptance: Steel-safe corrections, approved finish/texture, vent application fixture and cure, grill retention, cable strain relief and sealing process incorporated; updated controlled drawing and inspection plan.

tasks.name: T2 - Repeat trial and supplier first-article inspection
tasks.acceptance: Final resin/cavity/process samples and dimensional FAI accepted for dispatch; proposed 60 assemblies covers lab/qualification plus spares. Supplier trial uses factory working days, with no assumed weekend overtime.

tasks.name: T2 - Air shipment and incoming inspection
tasks.acceptance: Final T2 samples and FAI received with revision/cavity/lot traceability; incoming damage/count checks complete.

tasks.name: T2 - Integrated mechanical and electrical evaluation
tasks.acceptance: Repeat affected dimensional, sealing/cable, thermal, mic/RH, RF/GNSS and power tests. Final resin/adhesive/cable/antenna/PCB/firmware configuration logged. Manufacturing repeatability compared across cavities/builds.

tasks.name: G5 - T2 preproduction candidate accepted
tasks.acceptance: T2 loop target 4-6 weeks from correction release: 10 supplier workdays correction + 2 supplier workdays trial + 5 calendar days shipping + 10 engineering workdays evaluation. Candidate accepted for preproduction; Rev2/T1 formal campaigns are already running. T2 configuration and process changes enter explicit qualification delta review before market release.

tasks.name: 07 - Rev2 / T1 qualification in parallel with T2 tooling
Confirm lab bookings, sample matrix and regulatory configuration
tasks.acceptance: Quote/confirm staggered lab slots: Rev2 arrival/quick bring-up for electrical and conducted work, T1 molded samples for enclosure-sensitive work, and a T2 delta window. Document grant IDs, antennas, firmware/RF modes, cable/pack variants, representative sample agreement, test allocation and change policy. Schedule is not evidence a booking already exists.

tasks.name: Accept representative T1 assemblies for formal lab work
tasks.acceptance: Lab signs sample/configuration matrix: molded production-intent resin, antenna location/cables, fastening, pigtail/grill and ePTFE/adhesive stack with recorded dimensions/process. Hand-cut/applied parts can be accepted when they represent the intended controlled assembly method; printed materials do not establish molded enclosure qualification. Nonrepresentative items remain provisional and trigger affected T2 tests; no assumption that T1 is already equivalent.

tasks.name: Rev2 vehicle power qualification - prototype housing allowed
tasks.acceptance: Run signed ISO 7637-2 / ISO 16750-2 electrical tests as scoped, reverse battery, crank, jump start, load dump, hot plug, shorts and USB/source combinations on traceable Rev2 with representative harness/pack/load and firmware. Printed housing is acceptable only where the lab records that enclosure/thermal/mounting effects cannot invalidate results. Board/port ESD may start; final accessible-assembly ESD is a separate T1 task. Verify recovery/leakage; no blanket automotive-certified claim.

tasks.name: T1 accessible-assembly ESD and enclosed thermal confirmation
tasks.acceptance: Complete enclosure-dependent accessible-point ESD, USB/pigtail/button/seam discharge paths and worst-case enclosed thermal/radio-load checks on representative T1. Cross-reference early Rev2 power results; repeat affected tests where T1 grounding, mounting, heat flow or wiring differs. Final T2 changes require delta review.

tasks.name: T1 enclosure, environmental and cable qualification
tasks.acceptance: Run approved environmental/cable/membrane DVP&R on lab-accepted production-intent molded T1 assemblies: temperature/humidity/condensation/cycles, vibration/shock/drop, ingress target, scoped fluid/UV, pull/flex and connector/button life. Measure acoustic/RH response and bonding/grill performance before/after. Record controlled hand-assembly method where representative; substitute material or process results are provisional. T2 delta review determines repeats; long-duration aging adds explicit time.

tasks.name: T1 US FCC / Canada ISED host RF, emissions and exposure assessment
tasks.acceptance: Test/assess lab-accepted representative Rev2/T1 configuration against applicable rules and module grant restrictions, antenna gains/bands, simultaneous transmit modes, RF exposure and host emissions. Formal radiated results require representative mechanics; printed parts alone do not establish final conformity. Obtain reports/filing-route conclusion; final applicability to T2 is decided at explicit delta gate.

tasks.name: Rev2 cellular/operator and conditional NTN conducted / protocol campaign
tasks.acceptance: Begin applicable PTCRB/IoT/operator route on verified Rev2 and selected module/modem/NCS/SIM/provider: conducted RF, network/protocol, provisioning and SIM lifecycle work that does not require final enclosure. Printed housing may support bench work with lab agreement. OTA/antenna-dependent acceptance follows on T1; include conditional NTN service tests or documented disabled feature scope.

tasks.name: T1 cellular OTA / antenna and provider acceptance completion
tasks.acceptance: Complete required antenna/OTA and selected-carrier/provider acceptance on representative Rev2/T1 assembly, incorporating early conducted/protocol results. NTN approval evidence is included if selected. Record exact accepted hardware/firmware/antenna configuration; T2 changes are checked at the delta gate.

tasks.name: Complete Bluetooth product qualification
tasks.acceptance: Company membership, qualified-design reuse/testing route, product identity and submission complete; retain product qualification record before market distribution.

tasks.name: Battery, transport, material and product safety documentation
tasks.acceptance: Confirm actual cell/pack chemistry/configuration and applicable safety evaluation, protection/charging temperature behavior; UN 38.3 test summary for shipped lithium configuration and packaging requirements where applicable, supplier safety files, resin flammability and material declarations. New/modified pack testing requires a separate quoted loop; module approvals do not cover this.

tasks.name: T2 change-impact review and qualification carry-forward decision
tasks.owner: Compliance / accredited lab / EE / ME / quality
tasks.acceptance: Compare tested Rev2/T1 and final T2 BOM, PCB, antennas/matching, firmware/radio limits, resin/texture, geometry/seals, adhesive/membrane/grill, cable and assembly process. Lab/quality approve which reports carry forward and list affected tests/filings/acceptances for repetition; no automatic certificate transfer. Minor repeats use the visible reserve; major changes extend schedule. Release remains blocked until final configuration is covered.

tasks.name: Prepare labels, installation instructions and compliance file
tasks.acceptance: Prepare applicable US/Canada IDs/labels and Canadian bilingual notices as required, antenna/install separation, approved operating environment/power/accessories and provider scope. Reference Rev2/T1 reports and update to final T2 after delta/retest; final document approval occurs at G6. Expansion markets require fresh assessment.

tasks.name: T2 delta retests / lab confirmation reserve
tasks.acceptance: Reserve one minor affected-test/retest campaign and lab confirmation for final T2, including report/filing/operator acceptance and documentation updates. Lab-approved equivalence may reduce consumed reserve; no blanket acceptance of substitute housings/materials. Major hardware/antenna/resin/battery/NTN changes require an explicit longer loop; all affected tests must close before G6.

tasks.name: G6 - Qualification and US/Canada release evidence accepted
tasks.acceptance: Signed qualification reports and required authorizations/acceptances cover the exact final T2 sale configuration. T2 delta disposition and affected retests closed, final labels/manuals approved, and NTN inclusion/deferment explicit before customer distribution. Earlier Rev2/T1 results are carried forward only with documented lab/quality agreement.

tasks.name: 08 - Manufacturing system and software handoff gates
Design production programming and end-of-line fixtures
tasks.acceptance: Fixture design covers protected power, contact access, ESP32 USB/UART and nRF SWD/modem programming, serial/MAC/IMEI/SIM association, rail/current tests, radio/GNSS checks, sensor/mic/RH, buttons/RGB and leak/vent tests where appropriate. Throughput and calibration/reference strategy defined.

tasks.name: Build and correlate fixtures with golden/reference units
tasks.acceptance: Fixtures delivered, limits derived from qualification, reference/failing-unit studies demonstrate detection, gauge repeatability assessed and station/firmware logs retained. Destructive qualification and end-of-line screens have distinct coverage.

tasks.name: External gate - Factory firmware, provisioning and test tools
tasks.acceptance: Versioned manufacturing images, RF test modes, locked test protocols, fixture automation/dashboard diagnostics, protected factory identity flow, authorized provisioning and serial/IMEI/SIM records; pass/fail output schema and calibration persistence. No private keys or credentials in build package/logs.

tasks.name: External gate - Integrated product release candidate
tasks.acceptance: Versioned ESP32/nRF/shared/protobuf, mobile tools/onboarding/OTA, dashboard and AWS contracts pass cross-repo integration: cellular/Wi-Fi/BLE paths, location, recording/relay, secure ownership, updates, factory reset/calibration retention, recovery and low power. Feature maturity is not inferred from README. Separate software project manages scope and iterations.

tasks.name: Create assembly SOPs, quality control and training package
tasks.acceptance: Work instructions for membrane cleanliness/bond/cure, grill/screen retention, torque, seals/pigtail/USB, ESD/rework and traceability; incoming/supplier quality, PFMEA/control plan, calibration, first-article approval and operator training. Golden unit and tooling/fixture backups retained.

tasks.name: Approve production material availability and logistics plan
tasks.acceptance: Approved AVL, alternatives via ECO, allocation and forecast for radios/SIMs/antenna/resin/ePTFE/adhesive/cable/battery; no speculative full MP purchase. Pilot materials authorized; freight/customs/battery transport plan and supplier change notifications defined.

tasks.name: G7 - Controlled pilot build readiness
tasks.acceptance: Released exact hardware/firmware/BOM/work instructions, calibrated validated test stations, material, required compliance evidence and trained operators. Approve proposed PVT lot and quality targets before build.

tasks.name: 09 - Pilot, production release and ramp
Run PVT pilot on intended overseas production line
tasks.acceptance: Suggested 100-unit lot uses intended staff, tools, resin/process and end-of-line tests. Record first-pass yield, defects/rework, cycle time, cavity/lot/serial traceability and process capability where sample size supports it; retain golden/reference units.

tasks.name: Ship pilot units and verify receiving / fulfillment process
tasks.acceptance: Pilot import, packaging, handling and shipment records verified; random receiving audit matches station records and serial/SIM identities.

tasks.name: Supervised US/Canada vehicle pilot and soak
tasks.acceptance: Representative vehicles/installations and routes exercise cellular/GNSS/Wi-Fi/BLE, power/crank/sleep, heat/condensation, onboarding/OTA/recovery and optional approved NTN; retain logs with consent. Three weeks is a discovery pilot, not lifetime reliability proof.

tasks.name: Close pilot defects and approve yield / quality evidence
tasks.acceptance: Critical/major issues closed with retest and ECO impact assessment; baseline proposed targets >=95% first-pass yield, 100% functional screen pass before ship and zero unresolved critical defects require owner approval. Verify RMA/repair/OTA support and traceability.

tasks.name: G8 - Authorize mass production release
tasks.acceptance: Operator approves production quantity/PO against demand, cash, capacity and accepted quality. Qualified configuration and golden sample locked; change control, stop-ship and field monitoring owners assigned.

tasks.name: Build first mass-production lot and controlled ramp
tasks.acceptance: Size of first MP lot set at G8; control plan, sampling/audit, complete serialized test records, yield monitoring and supplier capacity demonstrated; hold nonconforming units.

tasks.name: First MP lot outgoing audit and shipment release
tasks.acceptance: Outgoing functional/visual/packaging audit and documentation pass, approved labels/manuals/certification configuration checked; ship only released units with traceability and support readiness.

tasks.name: G9 - First mass-production lot ready to ship
tasks.acceptance: First MP lot accepted and released for shipment; subsequent ramp managed by yield, demand and field performance. Freight to customer is outside this ready-to-ship milestone.
